content_fields.title: Verify that data exchanged between containers on different nodes on the overlay network is encrypted (Docker)
content_fields.description: Verify that traffic between containers on different nodes is encrypted.
content_fields.guidance: Verification means confirming the overlay network is created with encryption enabled and capturing inter-node traffic to confirm it is not readable in plaintext.
content_fields.found: The deployment is single-host Compose with no overlay network, so there is no cross-node traffic in this configuration.
content_fields.missing: A multi-node cluster and its overlay network configuration.
content_fields.conclusion: The verification applies to a clustered deployment that this repository does not define.
content_fields.action: The container platform team should verify overlay encryption if the service is deployed across nodes.
